title: Tea, iced, instant, black, decaffeinated, pre‑sweetened with sugar

content.title: About
content.content: Iced instant black tea, decaffeinated and pre‑sweetened with sugar, is a convenient beverage that prepares quickly by simply adding cold water. It retains the characteristic flavor of black tea while lacking the stimulating effect of caffeine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Instant tea was invented in the early 20th century as a way to brew tea where hot water was scarce.
Decaffeinated black tea is produced by a process that removes most caffeine while preserving flavor compounds.
Pre‑sweetening with sugar makes the drink more appealing to children and those who prefer sweet beverages.
Packaging in single‑serve sachets allows easy portion control.
Iced instant tea is popular at sports events and picnics because of its ease of preparation.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Black tea is rich in polyphenols, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: A caffeine‑free drink contributes to maintaining the body’s water balance.

items.title: Stress reduction
items.content: The lack of caffeine makes it suitable for evening consumption without risking sleep disruption.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: Sugar provides an immediate source of energy, useful during physical activity.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: Tannins in black tea can help normalize digestive processes.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Excessive sugar intake may contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of diabetes.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to tea components.

items.title: Decaffeination method
items.content: Some decaffeination processes use chemical solvents; choose products labeled “natural decaffeination” if this is a concern.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Tea can raise stomach acidity, which may be undesirable for individuals with gastritis.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: To prepare, dissolve one sachet (or the indicated amount of dry product) in 200‑250 ml of cold water and stir until fully dissolved. Optionally add a slice of lemon, mint, or ice cubes to enhance flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store sachets in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, use within 6‑12 months.
